steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Source analysis is a core skill in OCR J198, especially in the Depth Study paper | Key Fact: Always consider three elements: content (what it says), provenance (who wrote it, when, why), and context (what else was happening) | Key Fact: Ancient sources include writers like Herodotus, Thucydides, Livy, Polybius and Plutarch | Key Fact: Ancient sources may be biased, incomplete, or written long after events — always note their limitations
